newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen fluctuating on Jinro, Ssangyong.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen fluctuating on Jinro, Ssangyong.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to fluctuate at around the 700 level with financial troubles of the Jinro Group and Ssangyong Motor dampening buying sentiment, brokers said.
"Consolidation will continue. Financial problems with Jinro and Ssangyong were highlighted as they disclosed plans to sell off assets," said Na Min-ho of Daishin Securities.

The composite stock index ended 2.81 points lower at 701.39 on Tuesday. Jinro said on Monday it would sell its canned food and soft drink lines to improve its financial status. Ssangyong Motor said it was mulling a land sale.
Ssangyong said it was considering selling its building and real estate in southern Seoul to raise 70 to 80 billion won to repay its debt.
Analysts said Ssangyong's debts were estimated at 3.7 trillion won, while the company put them at 3.2 trillion won.
The automaker posted a net loss of 228.5 billion won in 1996 against 126.2 billion in 1995.
But brokers said rising customer deposits with securities houses would prevent sentiment from chilling too drastically.
The deposits rose to 3.11 trillion won on Tuesday from 3.06 trillion won on Monday. -- KIM MYONG-HWAN (822) 727 5645
